cond_0001.intro: Under the supervision of the Faculty Advisor and the Laboratory Manager the Section Leader is responsible for planning maintaining and monitoring all of the functions within a defined scope of testing within the department including ensuring that the department meets all standards set forth by CAP TJC CMS and AABB.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Maintains procedures and equipment for specified area of departmental testing. Maintains compliance with all standards set forth by relative accrediting agencies. Ensures appropriate instrument/equipment quality control performance and maintenance. Maintains appropriate inventories and effectively manages use of supplies and reagents. Performs laboratory procedures. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Clinical Laboratory Scientist
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree with completion of a NAACLS approved MLS/CLS program OR Bachelor's in Biology/Chemistry or related science OR Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology from a NAACLS approved MLT program OR Associate Degree or 60 semester hours with 6 hours in Chemistry and 6 hours in Biology and Accredited MLT Training
3 Years relevant experience
MLT, MT or categorical ASCP, or equivalent
Preferred Requirements
Experience in defined scope of testing
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or High School or High School Equivalency in Compliance with the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act & Amendments (CLIA)
3 Years relevant experience for Bachelor's degree or 5 years relevant experience for HS diploma
Preferred Requirements
HT or HTL, ASCP or equivalent
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
Job requires sitting, standing for prolonged periods, frequently walking, bending/stooping and reaching (overhead, extensive, repetitive); Repetitive motion: computer use. Proficient communicative, auditory and visual skills; Attention to detail and ability to write legibly; Ability to lift/push/pull 20 - 50lbs. May be exposed to fumes, chemicals, noise, radiation (in limited specific areas), blood/body fluids and infectious disease.

cond_0195.intro: Under the supervision of the Faculty Advisor and the Laboratory Manager, the Section Leader is responsible for planning, maintaining, and monitoring all functions within a defined scope of testing in the department. This includes staying in regular contact with team members and supervisors to ensure the department meets all standards set forth by CAP, TJC, CMS, and AABB.
cond_0195.responsibilities:
Maintains procedures and equipment for specified area of departmental testing.
Actively communicates with relevant staff to maintain compliance with all standards set forth by relative accrediting agencies.
Ensures appropriate instrument/equipment quality control performance and maintenance.
Maintains appropriate inventories and effectively manages use of supplies and reagents.
Performs laboratory procedures, coordinating with colleagues on a regular basis to keep operations running smoothly.
In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0195.requirements:
Clinical Laboratory Scientist
Education: Bachelor's Degree with completion of a NAACLS approved MLS/CLS program OR Bachelor's in Biology/Chemistry or related science OR Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology from a NAACLS approved MLT program OR Associate Degree or 60 semester hours with 6 hours in Chemistry and 6 hours in Biology and Accredited MLT Training
Experience: 3 years relevant experience
License/Certification: MLT, MT or categorical ASCP, or equivalent required
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
Education: Bachelor's Degree or High School or High School Equivalency in Compliance with the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act & Amendments (CLIA)
Experience: 3 years relevant experience for Bachelor's degree or 5 years relevant experience for HS diploma
License/Certification: HT or HTL, ASCP or equivalent preferred
Other Skills
Experience in defined scope of testing
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
Job requires sitting, standing for prolonged periods, frequently walking, bending/stooping and reaching (overhead, extensive, repetitive); Repetitive motion: computer use. Proficient communicative, auditory and visual skills; Attention to detail and ability to write legibly; Ability to lift/push/pull 20 - 50lbs. May be exposed to fumes, chemicals, noise, radiation (in limited specific areas), blood/body fluids and infectious disease.

This includes working with the team to ensure the department meets all standards set forth by CAP, TJC, CMS, and AABB.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to maintain procedures and equipment for the specified area of departmental testing.
Support compliance with all standards set forth by relevant accrediting agencies.
Help ensure appropriate instrument/equipment quality control performance and maintenance.
Maintain appropriate inventories and work with colleagues to manage use of supplies and reagents.
Perform laboratory procedures.
In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0234.requirements:
Clinical Laboratory Scientist
Education: Bachelor's Degree with completion of a NAACLS approved MLS/CLS program OR Bachelor's in Biology/Chemistry or related science OR Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology from a NAACLS approved MLT program OR Associate Degree or 60 semester hours with 6 hours in Chemistry and 6 hours in Biology and Accredited MLT Training
Experience: 3 years relevant experience
License/Certification: MLT, MT or categorical ASCP, or equivalent required
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
Education: Bachelor's Degree or High School or High School Equivalency in Compliance with the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act & Amendments (CLIA)
Experience: 3 years relevant experience for Bachelor's degree or 5 years relevant experience for HS diploma

Other Skills
Experience in defined scope of testing

Coordinates procedures and equipment maintenance for the specified area of departmental testing.
Supports compliance with all standards set forth by relevant accrediting agencies.
Works with the team to ensure appropriate instrument/equipment quality control performance and maintenance.
Helps maintain appropriate inventories and coordinates the use of supplies and reagents.
Performs laboratory procedures.
In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0279.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Clinical Laboratory Scientist
Education: Bachelor's Degree with completion of a NAACLS approved MLS/CLS program OR Bachelor's in Biology/Chemistry or related science OR Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology from a NAACLS approved MLT program OR Associate Degree or 60 semester hours with 6 hours in Chemistry and 6 hours in Biology and Accredited MLT Training
Experience: 3 years relevant experience
License/Certification: MLT, MT or categorical ASCP, or equivalent
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
Education: Bachelor's Degree or High School or High School Equivalency in Compliance with the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act & Amendments (CLIA)
Experience: 3 years relevant experience for Bachelor's degree or 5 years relevant experience for HS diploma
Physical Demands: Job requires sitting, standing for prolonged periods, frequently walking, bending/stooping and reaching (overhead, extensive, repetitive); Repetitive motion: computer use. Proficient communicative, auditory and visual skills; Attention to detail and ability to write legibly; Ability to lift/push/pull 20 - 50lbs. May be exposed to fumes, chemicals, noise, radiation (in limited specific areas), blood/body fluids and infectious disease.
Preferred Requirements
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
License/Certification: HT or HTL, ASCP or equivalent
Other Skills
Experience in defined scope of testing

Clinical Laboratory Scientist

cond_0418.responsibilities: Maintains procedures and equipment for specified area of departmental testing. Maintains compliance with all standards set forth by relative accrediting agencies. Ensures appropriate instrument/equipment quality control performance and maintenance. Maintains appropriate inventories and effectively manages use of supplies and reagents. Performs laboratory procedures. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0418.requirements:
Clinical Laboratory Scientist
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree with completion of a NAACLS approved MLS/CLS program OR Bachelor's in Biology/Chemistry or related science OR Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology from a NAACLS approved MLT program OR Associate Degree or 60 semester hours with 6 hours in Chemistry and 6 hours in Biology and Accredited MLT Training
3 Years relevant experience
MLT, MT or categorical ASCP, or equivalent
Preferred Requirements
Experience in defined scope of testing
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or High School or High School Equivalency in Compliance with the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act & Amendments (CLIA)
3 Years relevant experience for Bachelor's degree or 5 years relevant experience for HS diploma
Preferred Requirements
HT or HTL, ASCP or equivalent
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
Job requires sitting, standing for prolonged periods, frequently walking, bending/stooping and reaching (overhead, extensive, repetitive); Repetitive motion: computer use. Proficient communicative, auditory and visual skills; Attention to detail and ability to write legibly; Ability to lift/push/pull 20 - 50lbs. May be exposed to fumes, chemicals, noise, radiation (in limited specific areas), blood/body fluids and infectious disease.
cond_0418.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

Education: Bachelor's Degree with completion of a NAACLS approved MLS/CLS program OR Bachelor's in Biology/Chemistry or related science OR Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology from a NAACLS approved MLT program OR Associate Degree or 60 semester hours with 6 hours in Chemistry and 6 hours in Biology and Accredited MLT Training
Experience: 3 years relevant experience
License/Certification: MLT, MT or categorical ASCP, or equivalent required
Histotechnologist/Histotechnician
Education: Bachelor's Degree or High School or High School Equivalency in Compliance with the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act & Amendments (CLIA)

License/Certification: HT or HTL, ASCP or equivalent preferred
Other Skills
Experience in defined scope of testing
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
Job requires sitting, standing for prolonged periods, frequently walking, bending/stooping and reaching (overhead, extensive, repetitive); Repetitive motion: computer use. Proficient communicative, auditory and visual skills; Attention to detail and ability to write legibly; Ability to lift/push/pull 20 - 50lbs. May be exposed to fumes, chemicals, noise, radiation (in limited specific areas), blood/body fluids and infectious disease.

cond_0573.requirements:
Clinical Laboratory Scientist

Experience in defined scope of testing
